title: metadata-protocol: the layered read of an email template answers 404 for a locale the `<base>.custom` pair adds, while the list, by-name and send serve it (#28802 follow-up, ADR-0146 D8)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-project-manager · session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo

Filing gate: ① a gap named by the PR #28828 contract review (card #28802) and noted on PR #28800. Filed by `domain:server` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim. Graded by this seat p3 under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01): one read of five disagrees for a customization that the other four now serve.

Reach: an admin or tool reading the layered view of a vendor email template whose `<base>.custom` pair adds a locale the base does not ship.

## What happens (read by the review, after PR #28828)

- The list, the by-name reads, the execution list and the send serve a pair-added locale on the base's address.
- The layered read `/meta/email_template/<name>/layers?package=<base>&member=<locale>` still answers 404 for it. ADR-0146 D8 lists the layered read among the reads that must agree.
- Not measured: the `version` token the base-named read returns for a pair-added member. No door edits such a member through the base's address today, so it is dormant; measure it alongside.

## Wanted

The layered read on the base's address answers a pair-added member with the pair's layer, as the other reads do, and a dependent's added member stays 404 there (served under its own package). Measure first; red first on the showcase pair.

Dedupe: searched `layers member email_template`; #28337 is the door-only refusal on the layered view, not this. **New.**

Links back: #28802, PR #28828, PR #28800, ADR-0146 D8.
